title: Allard Regularity for Abelian Yang--Mills--Higgs Equation
summary: We study solutions to the self-dual Abelian Yang--Mills--Higgs (YMH) equations in the singular limit $\e \to 0 $, where the associated self-dual Ginzburg--Landau type energy \begin{align*} E_\e\begin{pmatrix}u\\ A\end{pmatrix} = \int_M \left( |\nabla^A u|^2 + \e^2 |F_A|^2 + \frac{(1 - |u|^2)^2}{4\e^2} \right) \mathrm{dvol}_g \end{align*} exhibits concentration along codimension-two sets. Using techniques inspired by Allard's regularity theory, we construct approximate solutions concentrating near a minimal submanifold and analyse their perturbations via a linearised operator projected…
